Three more outcomes in this same diff (EXP-52, EXP-53, EXP-55 are closed into it). Jack Heart (2026-11-12): "go ahead and close each and just put it into this diff".

1. (was EXP-52) Execution setup is provenance, like the seed. A report pools every game of one seating whichever tournament, environment setup or device played it, `compare`'s interval over all pooled matches, and still records how each game was run. Today `etude.page._newest_environment` keeps only the newest environment, and players whose configs differ only by how they were run (manabot's `compute` block: device, dtype) are distinct players. The experiment declares which environment/player config fields are setup (e.g. a `setup` key ignored for identity); Etude does not guess. A `Matches` by seating or tag covers every tournament, not one. Case: manabot TLA frontier, CPU env `tla-frontier-c5fba4-v1` and CUDA env `tla-frontier-c5fba4-cuda-v1` (`compute: {device: cuda, ...}`).

2. (was EXP-53) A curve over a seating scores the held checkpoint's seat only, so a checkpoint is never averaged in its role as someone else's earlier partner. Check this falls out of the design and test it. The frontier pairs with "the latest checkpoint at or before half the elapsed training hours", not an exact position: allow `Earlier`/`Fraction` to take the latest checkpoint at or before the target, resolved only once the line has a checkpoint past the target or has ended (so it never changes after), and recorded as resolved seats are. Exact stays the default.

3. (was EXP-55) `etude report FILE` reads held evidence without requiring `eval(state)` to agree with the current source digest: a finished experiment's page rebuilds from a later revision of its file, drawing exactly what its held runs recorded (manabot `tla_frontier.py` `_source()` hashes every `manabot/*.py`, so any later revision gets `tournament_conflict` 409 today). Scheduling new games (`etude eval`) keeps the conflict check. Do not fix with a manabot workaround or by editing frozen experiment files. Also noted there: an unscoped `--source r2://manabot/jobs` scan ran over 15 min and read 3.9 GB; count reads in a test for whatever path the report takes.
